name: Vjetrenica Cave, Ravno
description: Vjetrenica, whose name means "wind cave," is the largest cave in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It lies in the Popovo field near Ravno, in the Dinaric Alps. Its dark passages shelter an extraordinary number of cave-dwelling species, many found nowhere else, including the world's only subterranean tubeworm and "living fossils" whose closest relatives vanished long ago.
